node.statement: Coordinatization. Because P is a rank-three exact signed idempotent, it fixes its three-dimensional row space V pointwise, and every row-point p_Q of P lies in V and in the mass-one hyperplane H = {q : sum_j q_j = 1}; the intersection V∩H is a two-dimensional affine plane through p_v. Hence every row-point Q (actor, other full row-point fiber, or nonactor support fiber) has unique reals (x_Q, y_Q) with p_Q = p_v + x_Q·D + y_Q·E, and the five actors have coordinates v=(0,0), z=(1,0), o=(0,1), f=(-A,t), w=(-a·A, a·t).
node.inference: linear_algebra (idempotent fixes its row space; rows lie in row space ∩ mass-one hyperplane)
